Evaluations

How the technology holds up on real data.

Each evaluation fixes its scope and method before testing, then reports what happened, whichever way it goes. Any commercial relationship with the vendor is stated at the top.

The rule

Three commitments, made before any test.

01

Scope before test

What is being tested, on whose data, against which threshold. Fixed before the fieldwork starts and published with the result.

02

Relationship disclosed

If we hold a commercial relationship with the vendor, it is stated in the evaluation, at the top.

03

Result either way

Every evaluation we start is reported, including results a vendor would rather not see. That is what makes the good results worth trusting.
